## Title in 36pt UCL Sans SemiBold, no more than 1–2 lines

Use UCL Sans Regular no smaller than 24pt for body text, so it stays readable
and accessible.

Keep paragraphs short.

And remember:

- using bullet points
- often makes text
- easier to read

## Data visualisation colours

Only use these colours in graphs and charts, in this order (dark and light
alternate so neighbours contrast):

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
::: {.viz-swatches}
[Dark purple<br>#361A54]{style="background:#361a54"}
[Light green<br>#1AAB40]{style="background:#1aab40"}
[Dark blue<br>#12239E]{style="background:#12239e"}
[Light orange<br>#E66C37]{style="background:#e66c37"}
[Dark green<br>#10433F]{style="background:#10433f"}
[Light blue<br>#118DFF]{style="background:#118dff"}
[Dark red<br>#751441]{style="background:#751441"}
[Light pink<br>#E645AB]{style="background:#e645ab"}
:::
:::

::: {.content-visible when-format="beamer"}
```{=latex}
\begin{center}\small\color{ucloffwhite}
\foreach \c/\n in {1/Dark purple,2/Light green,3/Dark blue,4/Light orange,
                    5/Dark green,6/Light blue,7/Dark red,8/Light pink}{%
  \colorbox{uclviz\c}{\parbox[t][9mm]{14mm}{\tiny\n}}\hspace{0.5mm}}
\end{center}
```
:::

[Any chart using colour to convey meaning must include written alternatives
such as labels or alt text.]{.small}
